name: Quo
summary: Shared business numbers, texting and AI call summaries for small teams, formerly OpenPhone. Call reliability off Wi-Fi is the recurring complaint, and there is no video conferencing.
best_for: micro-teams of 2–5 people working mostly on Wi-Fi who want a clean, modern phone app built around a shared inbox, with AI call summaries (Sona)
skip_if: you're scaling past ~10 users and need rock-solid call infrastructure, you make lots of calls off Wi-Fi, or you need video: Nextiva or RingCentral fit better
honest_knock: Call reliability is the recurring complaint: G2 logs hundreds of connection and disconnection reports, and calls get shaky the moment you're off Wi-Fi. There's also no video conferencing, no 24/7 support on lower tiers, international calling costs extra, and the CRM integrations are shallow (the HubSpot app scores ~3.3/5).

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per user per month billed annually
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-08-31 against the vendor's own pricing page; all prices are quoted on the page in USD) (2026) Three tiers: Starter $15/user/mo annual (billed $180/yr) or $19 monthly; Business $23 annual ($276/yr) or $33 monthly; Scale $35 annual ($420/yr) or $47 monthly. 7-day free trial. When we went through signup on 18 November 2026, there was no way into the app without choosing a plan: the plan screen reads 'Choose a plan to start your 7-day free trial', and selecting Starter opened a 'Billing details' form with a card field. That page says 'we'll place a temporary $1 hold on your credit card upon signup' and showed $0.00 due today, with $19.00 billed on 25 November 2026 for one Starter user on monthly billing. The six plan prices matched the ones above. We stopped before entering a card. Taxes and fees are added at checkout and are not quantified on the page. Itemised extras: The Campaign Registry takes $19.50 once plus $1.50-$3/month to keep US carrier messaging deliverable, each additional phone number is $5/month, and international calling is billed per minute. The Sona AI answering agent is included on every plan with 1,000 automation credits a month (a call costs 100 credits, so ten calls); more credits run $25/mo for 4,000 up to $199/mo for 60,000, with per-call overage falling from $1.00 to $0.45 across those tiers. Re-verified 11 October 2026 on quo.com/pricing: all six rates, the $180/$276/$420 annual totals, the Sona credit tiers and overage rates, the $19.50 and $1.50-$3 Campaign Registry fees and the $5 extra number are unchanged. Two lines the earlier reading did not carry: the compare-plans table caps Starter at up to 10 paid users (Business and Scale unlimited), and Quo's help article 'Quo Plans and Pricing' (read 11 October 2026) adds a $15 Campaign Registry resubmission fee if a registration has to be resubmitted and lists the 16 states where telecom taxes are collected, based on your billing address. Re-read on 20 November 2026 on quo.com/pricing and quo.com/pricing.md: the six rates ($19/$15 Starter, $33/$23 Business, $47/$35 Scale), the Sona credit tiers and per-call overage, the $19.50 and $1.50-$3 registry fees and the $5 extra number are unchanged. The page now also prices Sona text conversations: overage runs from $0.50 per conversation on the free tier down to $0.225 on the $199 tier, a conversation counts once the lead has replied at least twice, and calls shorter than 15 seconds do not consume credits.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested Quo in the 7-day trial that we started with our card. The trial ran on Business Annual at $276.00 a year, not on a monthly plan. The inbox, a contact and the Sona call flow were set up, but no real call or text was made. Cancelling took one reason dialog with no offer, and the trial stays active until Nov 26. Account and start: we created the account and started the 7-day trial with his own card; the trial runs on Business Annual. Our AI assistant ran the test in our browser on 19 November 2026; the interface was in English. Core action, the inbox and a contact: the Primary inbox has the tabs Chats, Calls and Tasks and the filters Open, Unread and Unresponded, and showed Inbox cleared. You're all caught up. No real call or text was made. A test contact saved at once, with the fields Company, Role, Phone, Email, Access (Everyone) and Notes. Members shows No one in your workspace and Invite your team; inviting was off limits, so a shared team inbox was not tested. Sona, the AI that picks up calls: the Sona call flow was Live: Incoming call, Ring users All at once, for a total of 30s, If call is missed, Sona, Fallback, Voicemail. The Sona panel has a greeting with the workspace name, Knowledge Shared with Sona 1 of 1, the job Message taking and Caller history on. Personality: language English, Voice 1 (Default), tone Formal, Neutral or Casual. The Test Sona button hung on a loading dot and was not pursued. Recording: on the Primary number, Auto-record calls is on, Call recording notification is off and Transcribe and summarize calls is on. Integrations list CRM apps (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, Salesforce, Attio, Clio, HighLevel, Jobber, JobTread, Housecall Pro, monday CRM, Gong), Slack, Zapier and Make; none was connected. Plans and trial: Plan and billing shows Business Annual trial, 7 days left, You won't be charged until your trial ends on Nov 26. Plan charges $276.00: 1 x Business Plan at $276.00 a year and 1 x 1,000 Automation Credits at $0.00. Next payment: Billed on Nov 26, 2026, $276.00 USD. Credit usage is unlimited during your 7-day trial period; Credits remaining 1,000 / 1,000, resets Dec 19, 2026; overages are disabled and would cost $1 per call. Three invoices of Nov 19, 2026 are Paid at $0. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done the same day: Settings, Plan and billing, Danger zone, End your free trial. The text says the trial stays fully active until the end of the 7-day free period, and that all numbers are retained for 30 days before removal. End free trial opens the dialog We're sorry to see you go with six reasons and an optional feedback field; we picked Other and typed Just testing, then clicked Cancel subscription. No retention offer, no password and no support contact. After a reload the page said Your subscription was canceled. Your Business Annual plan expires on Nov 26, with a Reactivate subscription button. There is no screenshot of that page because it shows the payment method. Not tested: real calls and texts, teammates in a shared inbox, the Test Sona voice test, transcripts of a real call, US carrier registration, adding funds, overages and changing plan. Clean up: the test contact stays; the trial is cancelled and ends on Nov 26. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The trial we started ran on Business Annual, a yearly charge of $276.00, so check which plan the trial picks. The Test Sona button hung on a loading dot.
